2026-10-10 · updated 2026-10-11 · branch feature/claude-design-fidelity · manual test report

Claude Design fidelity pass

Every screen in the Claude Design exports (batch 01 + 02) was rebuilt to match its mockup, one view at a time, each confirmed with a side-by-side screenshot (mockup left, this branch right). Desktop at 1440×1024, phones at 390×844. Full per-screen status, deviations and the before/after evidence live in design-mockups/STATUS.md.

What changed

  • Shell — new rail (brand tile, groups, gold active bar, account menu) and top bar (search ⌘K, week chip, bell, New lesson). Tokens + fonts now load in the dashboard layout, so no page renders an unstyled shell. Parents get a single family-portal bar.
  • Dashboards — teacher, student, admin and parent rebuilt with real data (new query modules; admin aggregates paged past the 1000-row cap). Phones get the mobile mockups' own compositions.
  • Forms — shared kit (page header with actions, collapsible sections, student pills, filled-field tint); lesson, assignment (multi-student), song (with a phone wizard) and student forms.
  • Lists & details — lessons (desktop table, phone cards, student teacher column), lesson detail (+ phone), assignments (teacher board + quick assign, student master-detail), song detail (waveform player, tabs), student detail (stat tiles, activity).
  • Other screens — notifications activity feed, settings rail + integrations, sign-in / password-reset / onboarding role select, chord quiz home / question / summary / history, fretboard phone layout.
  • Bugs fixed — audit B1, B2, B3, B5, B6; onboarding inside the legacy shell; parent "latest note" quoting a future lesson; waveform hydration mismatch; landing duplicate React key. Found by the critical E2E run: on the phone song wizard, tapping Next on step III submitted the form (one button node flipped to type="submit" mid-click; now keyed apart); the lesson form crashed on a half-filled date/time pair; long song titles overflowed on phones; the student dashboard had no <h1>; the student assignment pane had lost its "Open full page" link.
  • New features the mockups assumed — chord-quiz game layer (XP, levels, a 40 XP daily goal, hearts that end a free-play round, day streaks; all derived from existing chord_quiz_attempts, no new table) and fretboard Save preset (new fretboard_presets table, migration 20261010120000, owner-only RLS with 4 RLS tests).
  • Teacher day spine now widens past 9a–8p when a lesson starts earlier or ends later, so no lesson is cut off.
  • Found by the full CI E2E run (416 tests): the redesigned student page had dropped the onboarding chips (guitars, goals), which are now restored under the header (StudentDetail.About.tsx); the teacher's "Needs attention" rows had lost their link, and now open the student's profile (practice gap) or the assignment (overdue). 23 specs written for the old UI were updated or, for pure layout checks, removed. CI now stops after the first failing test (E2E_MAX_FAILURES, default 1; 0 = full report).
  • Testing rule — .claude/rules/playwright-testing.md now limits E2E to critical flows and permissions (max 10 per feature); the full suite runs on the self-hosted runner, not as a local gate.

How to test

  1. Point .env.local at the dev stack (NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_LOCAL_URL=http://192.168.1.75:55321) and run npm run dev. Never the prod stack on :54321.
  2. Sign in with the dev accounts: teacher@dev.local, student@dev.local, admin@dev.local, parent@dev.local (passwords test123_<role>). For onboarding use a no-role account (e.g. onboard@dev.local / test123_onboard, created on dev for this pass).
  3. Dev data seeded for this pass (tag seed:design-qa / titles "Design QA ·"): a next and a last lesson for the student with notes and homework, ten days of practice sessions, an evening lesson today with two songs, six teacher notifications.
  4. For each card below: open the route as the listed role, compare against the screenshot, then try the listed interactions. Repeat at a 390px-wide window (DevTools device mode) for the "(phone)" entries.
  5. Edge cases worth a look: a student with no upcoming lesson (countdown shows "No lesson booked"); a teacher evening with all lessons finished (no hero on the phone dashboard); a 0-answer quiz history (empty states); settings as a student (only Profile + Notifications tabs); a song submit with a missing title on the phone wizard (jumps back to step I with the error).
  6. Automated gates: npm run lint (0 errors), npm run typecheck, npm test (333 suites, 4434 tests green), npm run test:rls for fretboard-presets, npm run check:structure clean. Critical E2E on Desktop Chrome, all re-run after the last change: smoke, role login, lessons / assignments / songs CRUD, student assignments + practice, parent dashboard, both journeys, duration format, repeat weekly, chord quiz — 53 passed, 4 data-conditional skips. Local runs need the Google-Fonts mock (Turbopack font fetch fails on this machine, origin/main too).
  7. Quiz edge cases: miss five chords in a row in free play → the round stops at question 5 with "Out of hearts"; do the same in a teacher drill (?drill=<assignmentId>) → it plays to the end. Play a second round the same day → the summary says "already counted today" and the streak does not grow.
  8. Restored features: open a student who completed onboarding → guitar and goal chips under the name (an unknown guitar key shows verbatim); a student without onboarding → no empty row. On the teacher dashboard, click a "No practice logged in N days" row → the student's profile; an "Assignment overdue" row → the assignment.
  9. Preset edge cases: an empty name is rejected; a name over 60 characters is rejected; sign in as a student → the teacher's presets are not listed.
